pages.attrib: Display or change attributes of files or directories.
pages.cd: Display the current working directory or move to a different directory.
pages.clip: Copy input content to the Windows clipboard.
pages.copy: Copy files from one location to another.
pages.curl: In PowerShell, this command may be an alias of `Invoke-WebRequest` when the original `curl` program (<https://curl.se>) is not properly installed.
pages.date: Display or set the system date.
pages.exit: Quit the current CMD instance or the current batch file.
pages.fc: Compare the differences between two files or sets of files.
pages.findstr: Find specified text within one or more files.
pages.Get-Command: List and get available commands in the current PowerShell session.
pages.Get-Content: Get the content of the item at the specified location.
pages.Get-Date: Get the current date and time.
pages.getmac: Display the MAC addresses of a system.
pages.Invoke-WebRequest: Perform a HTTP/HTTPS request to the Web.
pages.ipconfig: Display and manage the network configuration of Windows.
pages.more: Display paginated output from `stdin` or a file.
pages.Move-Item: Move or rename files, directories, registry keys, and other PowerShell data items.
pages.move: Move or rename files and directories.
pages.netstat: Display active TCP connections, ports on which the computer is listening, network adapter statistics, the IP routing table, IPv4 statistics, and IPv6 statistics.
pages.New-Item: Create a new file, directory, symbolic link, or a registry entry.
pages.ping: Send ICMP ECHO_REQUEST packets to network hosts.
pages.popd: Change the current directory to the directory stored by the `pushd` command.
pages.powershell: Command-line shell and scripting language designed especially for system administration.
pages.pushd: Place a directory on a stack so it can be accessed later.
pages.rd: This command is an alias of `rmdir` on the Command Prompt and `Remove-Item` in PowerShell.
pages.Remove-Item: Delete files, folders, as well as registry keys and subkeys.
pages.ren: This command is an alias of `Rename-Item`.
pages.Rename-Item: Powershell command to rename an item.
pages.rmdir: Remove a directory and its contents.
pages.Select-String: Finds text in strings and files in PowerShell.
pages.Set-Location: Display the current working directory or move to a different directory.
pages.shutdown: A tool for shutting down, restarting, or logging off a machine.
pages.start: Start a command in a new console.
pages.systeminfo: Display operating system configuration for a local or remote machine.
pages.taskkill: Terminate a process by its process ID or name.
pages.tasklist: Display a list of currently running processes on a local or remote machine.
pages.time: Display or set the system time.
pages.tracert: Receive information about each step in the route between your PC and the target.
pages.tree: Display a graphical tree of the directory structure for a path.
pages.type: Display the contents of a file.
pages.ver: Display the current Windows or MS-DOS version number.
pages.where: Display the location of files that match the search pattern.
pages.whoami: Display details about the current user.
pages.claude: An agent-based coding tool that understands your code base and helps you code faster through natural language commands.
pages.code: Cross platform and extensible code editor.
pages.codex: Natural language code assistant for the terminal, powered by OpenAI.
pages.gemini: Launch an interactive prompt with Gemini AI.
pages.git add: Stage changed files for a commit.
pages.git branch: Main Git command for working with branches.
pages.git checkout: Check out a branch or paths to the working tree.
pages.git fetch: Download objects and refs from a remote repository.
pages.git init: Initialize a new local Git repository.
pages.git pull: Fetch branch from a remote repository and merge it to local repository.
pages.git push: Push commits to a remote repository.
pages.git reset: Undo commits or unstage changes by resetting the current Git HEAD to the specified state.
pages.git restore: Restore working tree files. Requires Git version 2.23+.
pages.git show: Show various types of Git objects (commits, tags, etc.).
pages.git stash: Stash local Git changes in a temporary area.
pages.git status: Show the changes to files in a Git repository.
pages.git switch: Switch between Git branches. Requires Git version 2.23+.
pages.git tag: Create, list, delete, or verify tags.
pages.hostname: Show or set the system's host name.
pages.npm list: This command is an alias of `npm ls`.
pages.npx: This command is an alias of `npm exec`.
pages.pip freeze: List installed packages in requirements format.
pages.ssh: Secure Shell is a protocol used to securely log onto remote systems.
pages.uv add: Add package dependencies to the `pyproject.toml` file.
pages.uv pip: Provides pip-like commands for installing, uninstalling, and managing packages.
pages.uv run: Run a command or script in the project environment.
pages.uv venv: Create an isolated Python environment for installing packages.
pages.uv: A fast Python package and project manager.
